exposure: Tamoxifen administration protocols (late gestation with/without progesterone and estrogen)
outcome: Delayed delivery and/or mortality of pups
cohort: The study utilized ubiquitous CMV-CreERT2 transgenic mice and their pups.
finding: Efficient procedures were developed and validated to achieve efficient recombination of floxed alleles at perinatal stages.
mod_finding: Late gestation tamoxifen treatment resulted in delayed delivery and/or mortality of pups due to difficult delivery.
gest_age: Pups collected at E18.5 (embryonic day 18.5); targeted stages were late gestational or early postnatal.
